name: the chain record is never asked
why: The feature itself: without the /ws/js branch every chain climbs area-rels as before. The text is the same, so only the request counts see it.

name: the walk ignores a loaded chain record
why: _mbPopAreaChain() must end the walk with the record's areas; without it the record is fetched and then never shown, and the chain stays incomplete.

name: an answer for another area is accepted
why: The endpoint is undocumented: an answer that is not this area must fall back to the climb.

name: a failed record does not switch /ws/js off
why: Without _mbPopChainOff the climb asks /ws/js again at every level it reaches: three failures for one line.

name: the area itself is kept in its own line
why: A containment that lists the area would name it twice (Long Branch, Long Branch, …).

name: the line's areas are not seeded
why: Each area of a record's line gets its tail in memory, so New Jersey's own chain needs no request.

name: flagcdn.com on musicbrainz.org too
why: Question 4 of the mockup: musicbrainz.org keeps MusicBrainz's own flag, so no third-party request is made there.

edits.find: if (onMb) return ``;

name: an X code is sent to flagcdn.com
why: flagcdn has no flag for XE/XW (EH's flagI() skips every X? but XK): the box stays.

name: a failed flag image is not turned into its box
why: Question 2 of the mockup: without the listener a blocked image leaves an empty slot.

name: a failed flag image is not remembered
why: Every repaint of a window would ask flagcdn.com again and fail again.

name: the area window has no Part of
why: The row itself (question 3 of the mockup: the first fact).

name: Part of names the area itself
why: `above` drops the area from its own line: "New Jersey, United States" for Long Branch.

name: the area window does not ask the line
why: Without the load in pin() the Part of row only ever shows its spinner.

name: the area window asks its own state flag again
why: Part of leaves the area out, and its pictures already ask its P41: a second wbgetclaims P41 went to Wikidata for a state's window.

name: the area card keeps naming only the parent
